title: SCSE blinded annotator packet row

registered_question.description: Institutional registered oral-question text. Must be displayed before Q1 in human packets (codebook v0.3).

Q1.description: Oral question turn. Must be displayed.

R1.description: Prime Minister first response. Must be displayed.

registered_unavailable.description: If true, row must be flagged before ordinary annotation; empty registered_question may be permitted only under explicit validation allow-flag.

question_topic.description: Draft question-side topic for audit/sensitivity; must not determine reply_status.

description: From codebook v0.3: packets MUST display registered_question, Q1, R1 in that order. MUST NOT include party, parliamentary_group, formation_vote_alignment, primary_alignment, or questioner identifiers as metadata columns.
